newsitem.title: USA: Texaco picks BBDO for global ad account.
newsitem.headline: Texaco picks BBDO for global ad account.

text.p: Texaco Inc. said Monday it named Omnicom Group Inc.'s BBDO Worldwide unit as lead advertising agency on its corporate account.
The selection follows a five-month review, Texaco said.
The company did not elaborate on the size of the account.
Texaco and BBDO officials were not immediately available for comment.

Separately, Texaco said its contract with Iraq's State Oil Marketing Organisation (SOMO) was approved by U.S. and United Nations authorities but that the amount has been cut from that originally contracted.
"The contract has been approved but it has been reduced from 20,000 barrels a day to 10,000 barrels a day," a Texaco official said.

The reduction came at SOMO's request as it cut back amounts from a number of contracts agreed under the Iraq-United Nations "oil-for-food" deal because of worries that current high oil prices might mean it would overshoot the sales limit of $1 billion over three months.
Under the terms of the U.N. deal, Iraq can export up to $1 billion for three months.
